gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kumbh-sans: Balsamiq Sans draws bold, expressive letters in a stencil-cut channel of constant width, with no pinched curves anywhere. Kumbh Sans follows as a plain sans whose terminals stop well short of the bowl, like strokes from a fixed pen.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lato: Lato brings wide s curves that barely curl in. Against Balsamiq Sans, whose crossbars are as thick as its stems, that gap in stroke weight is the strongest thing the pair has going.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-libre-franklin: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans keeps its line flat and unmodulated from the first letter to the last. Libre Franklin sits beneath it with a splayed c terminal and a much lighter touch, so the two feel clearly different.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-livvic: Bold and expressive, Balsamiq Sans holds one constant weight and never pinches a curve into a tight corner. And Livvic, a plain sans with no stress in its curves and a generous opening in the c, gives that loud heading a friendly place to land.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lunasima: Bold, expressive letters come from Balsamiq Sans, with strokes as constant as bent wire. It earns its keep big and short, while Lunasima sits quietly beneath with c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: Balsamiq Sans has an o whose sides and top are equally thick, like a stencil-cut channel. LXGW Marker Gothic is the softer partner, a sans-serif with a bracelet-wide c and gentle shifts in thickness, and that tension is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-m-plus-1: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans carries a stencil-cut line with no pinched curves. And M PLUS 1, a plain sans with big open eyes on every e and a, is the quiet fineliner-flat counterweight that gives the pair its strength.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-m-plus-1p: Steady pen pressure runs through every Balsamiq Sans letter, first to last. M PLUS 1p, a plain sans with openness at every curve end, makes a longer passage feel light and unhurried after that heavier heading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-m-plus-2: Balsamiq Sans is bold and expressive, with a constant stencil-cut weight and no tight, pinched curves anywhere. M PLUS 2, a sans with a gaping c, is the friendly foil.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-m-plus-code-lati: A stencil-cut channel of constant weight defines Balsamiq Sans. Next to it, M PLUS Code Latin feels like neon tubing bent into letters, each c a wide pitcher mouth, so the two read as loud and glowing cousins.
